name: A Free Lunch
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
narrative.objectives: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
narrative.requestItemsText: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!
